text:
tara: opened PR to add novum9b to the catalog + a short migration guide for SDK v4. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/4987 — includes supported_variants, quant_profiles, seq limits (8k/16k), and quick perf numbers. please eyeball.

eli: thanks. can you drop single-line examples for streaming in both Python and Node, and a fallback pattern for embeddings on CPU-only instances? ops will want copyable snippets.

tara: added Python + Node streaming snippets and an embeddings fallback example using variant: "sparse-lite" and quant_profile: "cpu-int8". also included a small note about expected throughput drop on CPU (roughly 4-5x).

frank: CI lint flagged frontmatter key: used "max_seq_len" — must be "max_sequence_length" per catalog schema. quick fix pls.

tara: fixed to "max_sequence_length" and pushed.

maya: microbench request: can you add p50/p95 for 8k and 16k on A100-80GB and A10G? helps customers pick variants.

tara: added table: 8k p50 520 tok/s (A100), p95 410; 16k p50 205 tok/s (A100), p95 155. A10G ~60% of A100 numbers. noted variance with dynamic padding.

eli: tiny content nit: the anchor in Quant Profiles section points to "#quant-profiles" but our site anchors use "#quantization-profiles". will 404.

tara: fixed anchor and updated TOC.

frank: can eng-ml sign off on the CPU/quant quality wording? avoid definitive claims. @maya?

maya: tweaked language: "CPU quant fallbacks may increase latency ~3-5x and can change short-token choices; recommend running quick eval on representative prompts." added link to eval harness: https://bench.internal/novum9b/4987

ci-bot: preview build passed ✅ — staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4987. Lint: 0 errors, 1 warning (link style).

tara: added a short migration checklist in the PR description (key rename, new enums for quant_profile and supported_variants) and a changelog bullet. requesting final reviews from @eli @frank @maya. will merge after one approval. :rocket:
